summary: Clearwater NF lookout: camp 1915, cabin 1921, L-4 cab 1930 or 1931, 1934 fire account, 1953 concrete-based cab; gone by 1985; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab: a gabled cab on a 6-foot log base (1931), then a hip-roofed cab on an 8-foot concrete base (1953)
facts.status_note: Last used in the late 1960s or early 1970s per a 1981 history quoted on the Weebly page; confirmed gone in 1985 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

corrections.proposed: Last used in the late 1960s or early 1970s and then abandoned (1981 history quoted on the Weebly page); confirmed gone in 1985
corrections.why: 1985 is the year the lookout was confirmed or found gone (firelookout.com; Idaho Fire Lookouts). The Weebly page quotes a 1981 history placing abandonment in the late 1960s or early 1970s.

corrections.proposed: remove unless a source for a total height is found
corrections.why: No source read states a total height. The sources give base heights only: a 6-foot log base in 1931 and an 8-foot concrete base in 1953.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the gabled L-4 cab on a 6-foot base to 1931. The Weebly page dates the work to 1930 and gives an 8-foot-high base. The story reports both and does not choose.

The Weebly page quotes The Clearwater Story saying the lookout building burned in August 1934, and also says a cabin was manned through the 1953 season. No source read explains whether the building was repaired or rebuilt. The story reports both.

The 1981 history quoted on the Weebly page says last use was in the late 1960s or early 1970s, then abandoned. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1985 as the year it was confirmed gone. These are different events and the story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Three sources disagree on the 1930 or 1931 build and on the base height (6 or 8 feet). The 1934 burning and the cabin manned through 1953 conflict on the same Weebly page. The brief's 'abandoned 1985' is not supported as an abandonment date; the 1981 history quoted on the Weebly page gives the late 1960s or early 1970s for last use. No source read describes the site today, the road's condition or current public access, so the access block is omitted. Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site 'Drive-Up' and 'Removed / Destroyed' without explanation; the story quotes the tags (final paragraph, footnote 2) and does not read them as an access statement. The 1934 point is also an absence claim: none of the three sources explains how a building burned in 1934 came to be manned through 1953, so the story cites all three footnotes for it. Staffing is a partial list of named personnel (1917 to 1934), not a roster. The Weebly page's long quotes are from The Clearwater Story and a 1981 Lochsa history; I cited the Weebly page for them, not the originals. No photos added.
